items.name: c-signature-pad-1
items.title: Pinned clear and save
items.description: Muted signing surface with clear and save controls pinned inside the pad.
items.descriptionLong: Pinned clear and save. Built with the Signature Pad component. A free, open source shadcn signature pad example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-signature-pad-1 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-signature-pad-2
items.title: Undo and redo toolbar
items.description: Toolbar with undo, redo and clear, plus Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcuts.
items.descriptionLong: Undo and redo toolbar. Built by composing Button Group, Kbd, Signature Pad. A free, open source shadcn signature pad example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-signature-pad-2 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-signature-pad-4
items.title: Signing workspace
items.description: Ink colors, line weights, undo, redo, replay and PNG or SVG download in one signing card.
items.descriptionLong: Signing workspace. Built by composing Badge, Button, Card, Dropdown Menu, Separator and 1 more. Uses cn alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn signature pad example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-signature-pad-4 and edit as your own code.
